summary: Frontend-only test of the new 'Stampa moduli vuoti da compilare a mano' panel (StampaVuoto) on mobile (390px), using a temporary Firebase user. The panel sits under documenti-pratica-hint, is closed by default and opens with stampa-vuoto-toggle. It has 5 tipi and 12 document options (Tutta la documentazione + 11 single documents). I downloaded all 60 combinations (5 tipi x 12) and checked them with PyMuPDF. There were 0 console errors and 0 pageerrors, and no error toast. Blank collaudo: cliente, indirizzo, matricola and data are empty, the Esito column of the checklist is empty, every verifiche-di-consegna box is unchecked, and Positivo/Negativo have no cross. The normative texts, the zone di pericolo per tipo (they differ for each of the 5 tipi), the manuale and the informativa are present. Regression is OK for all 5 tipi: a filled pratica with esito Positivo and all 11 sicurezze has the Positivo box crossed, and the Analisi dei rischi is 1 page with the signature, no '(segue)' page and no 'Dispositivi di sicurezza installati' section. The full battente PDF is 15 pages with no orphan page. Some blank documents still come out partly pre-filled (see issues).

integration_issues.flow: Blank 'Registro di manutenzione (primo intervento)' (single document and inside 'Tutta la documentazione')
integration_issues.issue: toRegistro() is used on the blank pratica. The PDF crosses Installazione/Avviamento/Regolazioni and prints the description 'Installazione e messa in servizio in data [Data] ... matricola [Matricola]. Collaudo con esito positivo. Dispositivi di sicurezza verificati: fotocellule, ... Rischi residui: ...'. The empty esito becomes 'positivo' because of f.esito === 'negativo' ? 'negativo' : 'positivo'. This contradicts the rule that the esito must not be pre-filled.

The DM37 tipo 'nuovo impianto' and the uso edificio 'civile' are crossed by default, because of (m.tipo || 'nuovo') and (f.uso_edificio || 'civile'). On a form filled in by hand these choices should be empty. The boxes for the always-true declaration lines (iscritta registro imprese, seguito la normativa, ...) are acceptable.

issues: 'Utilizzo' is pre-filled as 'Privato / residenziale'. 'Misure adottate' is pre-filled from SICUREZZE_DEFAULT[tipo] and the Esito column shows 'Ridotto' for every row. A form filled in by hand should probably leave Misure/Esito (or at least Esito) empty, or offer boxes to tick.
Signature label reads 'Il tecnico (Italserrande S.r.l.) — data ' with nothing after it. Add a '____' line.
'Radiocomandi consegnati: -' should be a blank line ('____') so the number can be written in.

The 'Modalità di funzionamento' paragraph is pre-filled with 'comando impulsivo ... affidata a: fotocellule' (default comando and sicurezze). Consider a neutral text or boxes to tick for the blank form.
The Esito cells are empty, with no hint of C / NC / NA. A small 'C  NC  NA' tick row per cell would make hand filling easier (optional).

Because data is '', isNuovoReg() falls back to today's date. Blank forms printed now say Direttiva 2006/42/CE (old checklist and CE text). Blank forms printed in advance and used after 20/01/2027 will cite the wrong regime. Consider a regime selector, or a neutral text, in StampaVuoto.
'Targhetta CE: Applicata' and 'UNI EN 13241 Conforme' are pre-filled. Acceptable as company statements, but on a blank form they could be boxes to tick (low priority).

action_items: Blank registro (toRegistro): when esito is empty, do not write 'Collaudo con esito positivo' (use 'Collaudo con esito ____' or leave the description empty). Do not pre-cross Installazione/Avviamento/Regolazioni on the blank form.

Blank DM37: do not pre-select tipo 'nuovo impianto' and uso 'civile' when the pratica is blank (e.g. pass dm37.tipo = null and fields.uso_edificio = null, and only fall back to the default for real pratiche).

Optional: on the blank rischi form, leave the Esito ('Ridotto') and Utilizzo cells empty; collaudo 'Radiocomandi consegnati: ____'; rischi signature 'data ____'; offer a regime choice (pre/post 20/01/2027) for blank forms.
critical_code_review_comments: StampaVuoto.jsx: the download anchor is not attached to the DOM and the download bypasses sharePdf(). On mobile the PraticaDialog opens the share sheet, but here the app always downloads. That is inconsistent, though it may be intended. Also, in Playwright about 5 of the 60 clicks gave no 'download' event on the first try and worked on the retry. This is probably the automation harness, but appending the anchor to document.body before click(), or reusing sharePdf, is more robust.

blankPratica shares builders with real pratiche, and the defaults in toRegistro, dm37 and rischi turn empty values into positive or selected values. Add an explicit `blank: true` flag (or null-aware defaults) so the builders can render empty boxes and lines.
praticaPdf.js is 717 lines, over the 700-line limit. Consider splitting it (e.g. move Flow into its own module).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (60/60 blank PDFs generated without errors; collaudo blank and regression fully OK; 2 blank documents still pre-filled: registro esito positivo and DM37 defaults)

flaky_tests: The stampa-vuoto-scarica download event was missed in about 5 of 60 clicks (about 8%) and succeeded on retry. No error toast and no console error. Probably the harness.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup: python /app/backend/tests/iter54_ui_setup.py setup|cleanup (state in /tmp/iter54_ui.json). Blank flow: login → /documenti → documenti-tab-pratica → stampa-vuoto-toggle → select_option stampa-vuoto-tipo / stampa-vuoto-documento → expect_download on stampa-vuoto-scarica (retry once). Save as /tmp/iter54_blank_<tipo>_<doc|all>.pdf and run iter54_blank_pdf_check.py blank. It lists blue crosses with their labels, dates and the text 'esito positivo'. For the filled regression, save /tmp/iter54_filled_*.pdf and run 'filled'. Use add_init_script to set navigator.canShare/share to undefined.
